RelayButtons.state_pending: waiting for the vehicle to confirm
RelayButtons.state_failed: the vehicle did not confirm the command
RelayButtons.state_absent: this relay is not set up on the flight controller
RelayButtons.howItWorks: Each button switches a flight controller relay (MAV_CMD_DO_SET_RELAY). Relays on a CAN node are set up on the flight controller (RELAYn_FUNCTION / RELAYn_PIN). A button lights only when the vehicle reports the relay on, so switching from the transmitter shows here too.
RelayButtons.relayNumberTip: Relay number on the flight controller (RELAY1 = 1)
